name: Muv-Luv Alternative Chronicles: Rain Dancers
original_name: マブラヴ オルタネイティヴ クロニクルズ レイン・ダンサーズ
source:
Rain Dancers was originally a [url=/v92]Muv-Luv Alternative[/url] fanfiction written by [url=/s7978]Wei Luxin[/url].
It was officially recognized by Age and published by them during the [url=https://www.nitroplus.co.jp/pc/event/ditailed/081227/index.html]âge x Nitro+ Kanzen Gattai DX Godo Akiba Event[/url], the 27 December 2008, as part of a fanbook called MUV-LUV ALTERNATIVE LD2 PROJECT PROMINENCE.
Later, Chicken Divers was made into a visual novel which was released at Comiket 77, which took place during December 2009 (29-31). Unfortunately, this release was full of bugs.
The 30 July 2010, it was republished inside Chronicles 01, bundled with the databook MUV-LUV ALTERNATIVE LD3 Code：Rebellion. Voices were added and the production value enhanced.

Rain Dancers is a short story that takes place in November 1995. It details part of the effort of a combined European force using the brand new test EF-2000 Typhoons to create a foothold in Europe by retaking parts of Italy from BETA control.

[Synopsis from the [url=https://muvluv.fandom.com/wiki/Muv-Luv_Alternative_Chronicles_Rain_Dancers]Muv-Luv Fandom Wiki[/url]]
translation:
《雨舞者》原是[url=/v92]Muv-Luv Alternative[/url]同人小说，作者为[url=/s7978]魏鲁信[/url]。
它得到了Age的正式认可，并在2008年12月27日的[url=https://www.nitroplus.co.jp/pc/event/ditailed/081227/index.html]âge x Nitro+ Kanzen Gattai DX Godo Akiba Event[/url]期间出版，作为名为MUV-LUV ALTERNATIVE LD2 PROJECT PROMINENCE的粉丝书的一部分。
后来，《Chicken Divers》被制作成视觉小说，并在2009年12月（29-31）举行的Comiket 77上发布。不幸的是，这个版本充满了错误。
2010年7月30日，在Chronicles 01中重新发布，并捆绑资料册MUV-LUV ALTERNATIVE LD3 Code：Rebellion。添加了声音并提高了生产价值。

《雨中舞者》是一部发生在1995年11月的短篇故事。它详细介绍了欧洲联合部队使用全新测试型EF-2000台风战机，通过从BETA控制下夺回意大利部分地区，在欧洲建立立足点的部分努力。
